text: 告诉大家一个扎心的事实：近乎所有40岁男人没有选择的权利，只有被女人选择后，才有权利去考虑；
en: Let me tell everyone a harsh truth: nearly all men of forty have no right to choose; only after being chosen by a woman do they have the right to consider;

text: 40岁底层男女，迫于不得已才会在一起，他们不是不想选，而是没得考虑；
en: Men and women at the bottom at forty come together only out of necessity; it is not that they do not want to choose, but that they have nothing to consider;

text: 40岁条件一般男人，根本不在40岁女人考虑范围内。
en: Men of forty with average conditions are simply not within the consideration of women of forty.

text: 这部分男人已经被40岁女人开除了”球籍“。
en: This group of men has already been expelled from the 'dating pool' by women of forty.

text: 只有二三十岁的女生会选择40岁的男人，40岁的男人也只能考虑她们。
en: Only girls in their twenties and thirties will choose men of forty, and men of forty can only consider them.

text: 40岁条件好点的男人，女人不仅在40岁时会选择，女人回到20岁、30岁时依然会选择。
en: Men of forty who are slightly better off—women will choose them not only at forty, but would still choose them even if the women went back to being twenty or thirty.

text: 只是女人二三十岁时比40岁的自己有优势。
en: It is just that women in their twenties and thirties have an advantage over their forty-year-old selves.

text: 所以这不是男人考虑不考虑的问题，而是女人的内部矛盾。
en: So this is not a question of whether men consider or not, but an internal contradiction among women.

text: 只有处于食物链顶端的男人才有选择权，而不是考虑权；
en: Only men at the top of the food chain have the right to choose, not merely the right to consider;

text: 女人都更喜欢年轻时的自己，为啥男人就不能爱屋及乌，喜欢年轻时的你呢？
en: Women all prefer their younger selves, so why can't men, by the same token, come to like the younger you?

text: 我也不知道我上面说的对不对，但老师从小就教育我，科学的确是一门严谨的学科，强调以客观事实和可重复的实验作为依据。
en: I don't know whether what I said above is right or not, but my teachers have taught me since childhood that science is indeed a rigorous discipline that emphasises objective facts and repeatable experiments as its basis.

text: 尊重实验结果是科学研究的重要原则之一。
en: Respecting experimental results is one of the important principles of scientific research.

text: 当新的实验结果与现有理论相悖时，这往往会引发对理论的重新审视和修正
en: When new experimental results contradict existing theories, this often triggers a re-examination and revision of the theories

text: 这种对实验结果的尊重体现了科学的客观性和自我纠错能力。
en: This respect for experimental results reflects the objectivity and self-correcting capacity of science.

text: 它促使科学家们保持开放的思维，不固执于既定的观念。
en: It prompts scientists to maintain an open mind and not cling obstinately to established notions.

text: 同时，这也提醒我们在探索科学的道路上要秉持严谨和实事求是的态度，依靠可靠的实验数据来推动知识的进步。
en: At the same time, this also reminds us that on the path of exploring science we must uphold a rigorous and realistic attitude, relying on reliable experimental data to advance the progress of knowledge.

text: 只有这样，科学才能不断发展，更好地为人类服务。
en: Only in this way can science continue to develop and better serve humanity.

text: 我们同样20岁的时候
en: When we were both twenty

text: 你年轻貌美青春有活力，我一穷二白傻得冒泡事业刚刚起步，最多就是能判断有没有潜力，那时你不考虑身无分文的我
en: You were young and beautiful, full of youthful vitality, while I was penniless and clueless with a career just starting out; at most I could judge whether there was potential, and back then you did not consider me, who had not a penny to my name.

text: 现在我们同样40岁了
en: Now we are both forty

text: 你年老色衰皮肤松弛青春不在生育能力跟20岁我的经济能力一样，我资产A8事业稳定收入还在逐年上升，那现在的我不选择你很难理解吗
en: You have aged and lost your looks, your skin is slack, your youth is gone, and your fertility is like my financial capacity at twenty; I have assets at A8, a stable career, and my income is still rising year by year—so is it so hard to understand that I now do not choose you?

text: 别以为自己最聪明，别人都傻，现在这年头谁都不傻，如果20岁你选择了我，咱俩一起奋斗，然后现在40岁男的抛弃女性，无论哪个年代都是会被唾弃的。
en: Don't think you are the smartest and everyone else is foolish; these days nobody is foolish. If you had chosen me at twenty and we had struggled together, and then now at forty the man abandoned the woman, that would be condemned in any era.

text: 人都是自私的，这是本性，谁都会在有选择的时候，选择最利于自己的选项，不是吗
en: People are all selfish; this is human nature. Everyone, when they have a choice, will choose the option most favourable to themselves, won't they?

text: 男人，如果可以的话，永远都会找比自己小的！
en: Men, if they can, will always look for someone younger than themselves!

text: 30岁的男人嫌弃30岁女人老，要找二十四五岁的。
en: Thirty-year-old men disdain thirty-year-old women as old and want to find someone twenty-four or twenty-five.

text: 40岁的男人嫌弃40岁的女人老，要找30岁的，最好二十四五岁的。
en: Forty-year-old men disdain forty-year-old women as old and want to find someone thirty, preferably twenty-four or twenty-five.

text: 50岁的男人嫌弃50岁的女人老，要找40岁的，如果可以的话，30岁的更好，当然，如果二十四五岁愿意的话也挺好的。
en: Fifty-year-old men disdain fifty-year-old women as old and want to find someone forty; if possible, thirty would be even better, and of course, if someone twenty-four or twenty-five were willing, that would be quite good too.

text: 60岁的男人嫌60岁的女人老，要找40岁的，如果有30的或者二十四五岁的也可以。
en: Sixty-year-old men disdain sixty-year-old women as old and want to find someone forty; if there were a thirty-year-old or someone twenty-four or twenty-five, that would do as well.

text: 所以，有七八十的男人找了三十的女的生孩子的，五六十的当爹不算老，简直是笑哭了
en: So there are men in their seventies or eighties who found thirty-year-old women and had children; men in their fifties or sixties becoming fathers is not seen as old—it is simply laughable.

text: 然而，女人也会找比自己小的男人，一个朋友家的亲戚的女儿，36岁，找了个26岁小伙，女方爸爸很有钱，上司公司老总。
en: However, women will also find men younger than themselves. A relative's daughter of a friend's family, thirty-six, found a twenty-six-year-old lad; the woman's father is very wealthy, a company boss.

text: 所以，大棚乱了四季，金钱乱了年龄，其实也不是男人为啥喜欢比自己小很多的女人，男人要找比自己小很多的女人也得有实力，而女人也一样，有实力照样也可以。
en: So greenhouses have thrown the four seasons into disorder, and money has thrown age into disorder. Actually it is not that men particularly like women much younger than themselves; for a man to find a woman much younger he also needs means, and women are the same—with means they can do it too.

text: 我记得相亲市场一个大爷还是大妈怼40岁左右女：你都停水停电了还来相亲？
en: I remember in the matchmaking market an old man or old woman snapped at a woman of around forty: 'You've already had your water and electricity cut off, and you still come to matchmake?'

text: 其实是条件好的40岁男不考虑40岁女
en: In truth it is that well-off men of forty do not consider women of forty.

text: 本来也是，我今年也40左右
en: That is only natural; I am also around forty this year.

text: 如果我可以选，我肯定也选年轻的啊
en: If I could choose, I would definitely choose a younger one too.

text: 你40都断水断电了
en: You, at forty, have already had your water and electricity cut off.

text: 那些条件不好的40岁男
en: Those men of forty who are not well off

text: 找什么样的可能都能接受
en: might accept whatever kind of partner they find

text: 只是许多40岁女看不上。
en: It is just that many women of forty look down on them.

text: 你得知道一个问题，40岁女在婚恋场合上需要战胜的
en: You need to understand one thing: what a woman of forty needs to defeat in the marriage and dating arena

text: 不是对面的40岁男人，你说我比你这里强那里厉害就行了
en: is not the forty-year-old man opposite her; it is no good just saying 'I am better than you here and stronger than you there.'

text: 你需要战胜的，是和你竞争的20多岁的女人
en: What you need to defeat is the twenty-something woman competing with you.

text: 就拿我来说吧，我45岁，男性，离异单身，小孩跟前妻，
en: Take me for example: I am forty-five, male, divorced and single, with the child living with my ex-wife;

text: 主业一个月6300，副业一个月2400，
en: My main job brings 6,300 a month, my side job 2,400 a month;

text: 178高，142斤重，有薄肌，有点雄秃，
en: I am 178 centimetres tall, weigh 142 jin, have some slight muscle, and am slightly male-pattern bald;

text: 就我这个条件 ，也在交友软件里找女朋友，
en: With conditions like mine, I still look for a girlfriend on dating apps;

text: SOUL里的女的，装的太多，但我听发小王胖子的劝，换了赛道，有进步；
en: The women on SOUL put on too many airs, but I took the advice of my childhood friend Pangzi Wang and switched tracks, and made progress;

text: 别的交友软件里，可能好一些，但还是不靠谱，
en: On other dating apps it might be a bit better, but still unreliable;

text: 三年前，还没离，去过一次南京玄武湖的相亲角，是在等前妻和女儿上厕所，
en: Three years ago, before the divorce, I went once to the matchmaking corner at Nanjing Xuanwu Lake, while waiting for my ex-wife and daughter to use the lavatory;

text: 我在里面绕了一圈，7-8个大妈来找我，说可以介绍对象，说我这样的挺好
en: I walked around inside, and seven or eight old women came to me, saying they could introduce a partner, and that someone like me was quite good.

text: 我就知道，45岁男，完全可以找35岁女，如果那个女的意识到了什么！
en: Then I realised: a forty-five-year-old man can absolutely find a thirty-five-year-old woman—if that woman realises something!

text: 没房没车的女人为什么不考虑没房没车的男人？
en: Why do women with no house and no car not consider men with no house and no car?

text: 我身边就有一个40+的未婚女，我同学。
en: Right by my side there is an unmarried woman over forty, a classmate of mine.

text: 她如果不想结婚，咱们也不讨论，但她从咱们10多岁做同学认识，她就表现对异性有兴趣，所以这个话题如问题，咱们可以聊下去。
en: If she did not want to marry, we would not discuss it, but ever since we met as classmates in our early teens she has shown interest in the opposite sex, so this topic, as a question, we can continue to discuss.

text: 我们同学圈几十年，没结婚的很少，但就是这位同学，寡到了现在，她本人并不知道原因。
en: Our classmate circle over decades has very few who never married, yet this particular classmate has remained single to this day, and she herself does not know the reason.

text: 原因其实很简单，我们这些同学都不好直接告诉她，怕她无法接受，用我们四川话来讲，就是她很“神”。
en: The reason is actually very simple; we classmates do not feel comfortable telling her directly, for fear she cannot accept it. In our Sichuan dialect, she is very 'shen'.

text: 怎么个“神”法？
en: In what way is she 'shen'?

text: 举例:
en: For example:

text: 上学时，她特别喜欢出风头。
en: At school, she particularly liked to show off.

text: 一般受人关注的同学，不是成绩好，就是长得好，或者有某些特长。
en: Classmates who generally attracted attention were either good at studies, good-looking, or had some special talent.

text: 但她没有，她不算漂亮，成绩也很一般，也没特长，她出风头的方式就是和人抬杠，讲人坏话。
en: But she had none of these; she was not particularly pretty, her grades were mediocre, and she had no talent. The way she showed off was by arguing with people and speaking ill of others.

text: 比如有同学交女朋友，她就到处跟人讲别人的女朋友长得不好看，又和谁有过绯闻，还不是背地里说，是大张旗鼓说。
en: For instance, when a classmate got a girlfriend, she would go around telling everyone that the girlfriend was not good-looking and had rumours with someone else—and not behind their backs, but proclaiming it openly.

text: 这种性格造成的后果是，班里不管男生女生都说她脑子有点毛病，和她离得远远的。
en: The consequence of this personality was that, in the class, whether boys or girls, everyone said there was something wrong with her head, and kept their distance from her.

text: 第二件事，大学毕业，到了可以谈婚论嫁恋爱的年纪，她终于有了机会认识一个男的。
en: The second matter: after graduating university, at the age when one can talk of marriage and romance, she finally had a chance to meet a man.

text: 可惜这男的是她一个女同学的男朋友，这时她不管不顾和男的混在了一起，终于事情败露，被对方知道了。
en: Unfortunately this man was the boyfriend of one of her female classmates; at this point, heedless of consequences, she got involved with him, and in the end the affair came to light and was discovered by the other party.

text: 那男的也渣，当然作出了选择，把她甩了。
en: That man was also a jerk and, of course, made his choice and dumped her.

text: 你说这种男的，甩了就甩了，自己好好调整，过段时间走出来，也没什么问题。
en: Such a man—once dumped, so be it; she should have adjusted well and moved on after some time, and that would have been no problem.

text: 可她偏偏走不出来，成天吟诗作对，沉迷与此好多年，和男的私下断断续续联系好多年，人家娃都生两个了，两人还在朋友圈里互动。
en: Yet she simply could not move on; she spent all day composing poetry and matching couplets, obsessing over it for years, and kept in intermittent private contact with the man for years—by the time he had two children, the two were still interacting in their friend circles.

text: 这是不是脑子有坑？
en: Doesn't this show there's a screw loose?

text: 中间家里人急给他介绍男朋友，她也去，质量有好有坏，她也交往过两个，记忆中还带出来一个和我们这些老同学见面吃饭。
en: In between, her family anxiously introduced boyfriends to her, and she went along; the quality varied, and she did date two of them. As I recall, she once brought one out to meet us old classmates for a meal.

text: 有一回没事，她就和我聊天，聊起她相亲的男朋友，我就说没什么问题合适就可以结婚啦。
en: Once, with nothing to do, she chatted with me about the boyfriend she met through matchmaking, and I said there was no problem and if it was suitable they could marry.

text: 她就开始吐槽了，开口闭口“他龟儿子”怎么样怎么样，没一句好话，看不出来对别人半点尊重，我也不好说什么，草草结束聊天。
en: She started to complain, constantly saying 'that turtle's son' this and that, not a single good word, showing not the slightest respect for the other person. I had nothing to say, and ended the chat hastily.

text: 往后很多年，我们没什么联系。
en: In the many years that followed, we had little contact.

text: 中间有个男同学离婚后又想找对象，因为和那个女同学离得近，可能产生了一点想法，就和我聊天，问我“你觉得那Xxx怎么样”？
en: In between, a male classmate who had divorced wanted to find a partner again; because he lived near that female classmate, he may have developed some ideas, so he chatted with me and asked, 'What do you think of that Xxx?'

text: 我委婉地说，你想想以前咱们上学的时候，大家为什么都不待见她就行了，现在大概也差不多。
en: I said tactfully, just think back to when we were at school and why everyone disliked her, and now it is probably much the same.

text: 然后就没有然后，男同学也就此打住。
en: Then there was no 'and then'; the male classmate dropped it there.

text: 直到现在，那位女同学也单着，年轻时没找到合适的，现在更难找了，至于以后会不会遇到合适的，谁知道？
en: Until now, that female classmate is still single; she did not find someone suitable when young, and it is even harder now. As for whether she will meet someone suitable in future, who knows?

text: 我们的同学圈，如果碰头聊起她（如果能想起的话），都会觉得她很“神”，缺根弦。
en: Our classmate circle, if we meet up and happen to mention her (if we can remember), would all feel she is very 'shen'—missing a screw.

text: 然而，可能她并不知道别人对她的评价，或许也不在意别人的评价。
en: Yet, she probably does not know others' evaluation of her, or perhaps does not care about others' evaluation.

text: 毕竟，我们也无权对别人定义。
en: After all, we have no right to define others.
